gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Tourney is cut in one constant width, stretched wide and bulky. Noto Sans Tirhuta follows with trimmed terminals and a tall x-height, so a longer passage reads open and clean.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Noto Sans Ugaritic sits low, its letter mouths left open like unjoined chalk arcs, under a heading drawn with a drafting pen's single nib width. Tourney makes the loud outline statement; the sans-serif handles the quiet part.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-vai: Chunky, stretched and sporty, Tourney keeps its n arches as heavy as the stems beside them. Noto Sans Vai sets words in solid blocks beneath it, so the two settle together.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Tourney feels like tracing a single thick thread, every stroke cut to one width and spaced wide. Noto Sans Vithkuqi sits beneath with open throats and a small cap-to-lowercase step, easing the weight.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Tourney holds a single line weight from first letter to last, bulky and widely tracked. Noto Sans Wancho, a plain sans with a hulking lowercase, feels just as sturdy beside it.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Noto Sans Warang Citi sets its words in solid blocks, with wide channels leading into each counter, under Tourney's wide, single-weight capitals. And a longer stretch of this plain sans would read smoothly, with nothing swinging thick to thin.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-yi: Tourney stretches wide and bulky, with no modulation between its stems and connecting strokes. And Noto Sans Yi gives it a deep-bodied lowercase with unsealed rounds, which is where the pair gets its strength.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-squar: Wide gaps and a soaring x-height keep this body text crisp even at tiny sizes. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square then stands beneath Tourney, whose s has a spine as thick as its terminals.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-traditional-nushu: Tourney has zero modulation in its line, just wide, bulky, athletic shapes. Noto Traditional Nushu, a plain sans with a broad-nibbed stroke and bowls filling the line, would read in a friendly, steady way over a longer passage.
gen-tourney-gf-numans: Tourney paints every letter like a sign-painter's single brush stroke at constant width, stretched wide. Numans, a plain sans with swollen lowercase and generous tracking, gives the pair its strongest quality: a chunky, loosely spaced rhythm.
